text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock Q3 priorities for private deployments (VPC + on‑prem). Customers keep asking for easier upgrade lanes and a clearer customer-managed networking contract. Can we list the minimal launch criteria and one proposed sequencing?

Kai: +1. From infra POV: must have deterministic IP allocation docs, clear rollback path, and automated health probes for staged upgrades.

Jordan: For field: prioritize 2 things — zero-downtime upgrade for tenant control planes, and a supported pattern for customer NATs/firewalls. Those unblock 3 large prospects.

Sam: reality check: zero-downtime is heavy. Propose an MVP: "soft-rolling" upgrades (canary -> staged -> full) with documented maintenance window fallback. Ship that first, then iterate to true zero-downtime.

Priya: That sounds reasonable. Can we write explicit launch gates? I suggest: 1) automated staged rollout tooling in console, 2) upgrade rollback < 10m per tenant, 3) customer-facing network runbook and IP/CIDR compatibility matrix, 4) at least one pilot customer completed end-to-end.

Kai: I'll add runtime constraints: artifact signing for onprem installers, offline checksum verification, and a health-probe endpoint that returns simple JSON: 

```
GET /_health
200 {"status":"ok","version":"x.y.z"}
```

Jordan: For the network runbook, include sample iptables rules and a minimal required egress list for telemetry. Also: a short troubleshooting checklist for 'traffic stuck at customer edge' cases.

Sam: Ops ask: add a metric for upgrade progress (percent tenants upgraded + failures) and a per-tenant rollback button in the console. We can scope the UI as an MVP with a toggle + confirmation.

Priya: Good. Who owns the customer-managed networking contract language? We need legal-approved minimal SLAs and a list of operations we won't support.

Jordan: Product + Legal. I'll draft the first pass and include the 3-tier support boundaries: (1) config guidance, (2) assisted debugging on paid plan, (3) full troubleshooting only under a separate SOW.

Kai: Dependencies: eng-runtime needs small change to expose upgrade-status API; eng-infra needs packaging changes for signed artifacts; eng-oncall needs playbook updates.

Priya: Proposed sequencing (sprint-level):
- Sprint 1: runbook + CIDR matrix + legal draft + pilot candidate selection
- Sprint 2: staged rollout tooling + health probe + upgrade-status API
- Sprint 3: pilot execution + per-tenant rollback UI + metrics
- Sprint 4: iterate on zero-downtime automation if pilot shows demand

Sam: Sounds doable. Can we commit to timeframe for pilot? Recommend 6 weeks after Sprint 2 completion.

Jordan: I'll coordinate with field and schedule two pilot customers (one cloud VPC, one onprem air-gapped).

Priya: Action items: 
- Jordan: draft runbook + pilot invites (due EOW)
- Kai: design health-check and artifact signing plan (due next Tue)
- Sam: sktech console flow for rollback + metrics (due next Wed)
- Priya: compile launch gates doc and share with legal (due EOW)

deploy-bot: Release planner created: private-deploy-q3-roadmap (id: rp-1147) — milestones: runbook, rollout-tooling, pilot.

Priya: Thanks — tagging @Sam @Kai @Jordan. We'll reconvene Friday to review drafts. :party_parrot:
